text:
Anya: Quick design review — want eyes on a few chart tweaks I'm about to ship for the Console metrics dashboard:
- density overlay behavior and discoverability
- legend accessibility and compact state
- axis unit abbreviations vs scientific notation
- smoothing default and how we handle extreme outliers
Posting proposed copy + a tiny config snippet.

Matt: tl;dr: don't force smoothing on by default. Power users need peak spikes visible.

Cecilia: Agree. For density overlay, could we expose an opacity slider (0-100) instead of a binary on/off? :thinking:

Anya: Opacity slider is interesting — makes it discoverable but adds UI complexity. Maybe auto-collapse the control in compact/thumbnail modes.

Yu: Axis units: prefer explicit suffixes (e.g., 'req/s', 'ms') instead of scientific notation. Abbrev k/M is fine for large numbers.

Sam (design): Accessibility nit — legend items must have clear screen-reader text. Suggest aria-label="Legend: latency p50, p95, density" and role="group" on the legend container.

Matt: Outlier handling idea: clamp values above 99.9th percentile by default and surface a small header indicator 'clipped' with hover: "Top 0.1% values hidden — click to expand". Keeps charts readable.

Anya: Draft config for engs:
```
chartOptions: {
  smoothing: false, // default off
  density: { enabled: true, opacity: 0.35 },
  axisUnits: 'auto', // prefer explicit suffix when known
  outlierClamp: { percentile: 99.9, showIndicator: true }
}
```

Cecilia: Love the indicator. Make it keyboard-focusable and announce clamp state via a live region when toggled so screen readers get context.

Yu: Micro copy tweak: tooltip should use shorter language — e.g. "Top 0.1% values hidden — show" rather than "99.9th percentile". Numbers parse faster in tiny tooltips.

Anya: Performance note: density overlay is a rendering hit. Default opacity 0.35 for long time ranges, bump to 0.6 for short ranges to keep visibility while reducing overdraw.

Sam (design): Compact mode: collapse legend to "Latency (p50/p95)" with a disclosure to expand full legend. This keeps dashboard rows tight.

Matt: Also persist smoothing/density prefs per-user per-dashboard for pinned charts — avoids surprising changes for power users.

Cecilia: I'll mock a compact legend + clamp indicator in Figma and post the link. :eyes:

Chartbot: Deploy preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/figma/patch-123 (expires in 48h)

Anya: Thanks — Cecilia, please post the mock and I'll update the PR with aria attributes and config defaults. Can someone summarize action items?

Cecilia: Action items:
- mock compact legend + clamp indicator (Cecilia)
- add aria labels & live region behavior (Sam + Eng)
- implement config defaults & per-user persistence (Eng)
- apply copy tweak to tooltip (Anya)
I'll file tickets after the mock and link them here.

Matt: :thumbsup:

Yu: :+1:

Anya: Closing note: keep an option to export full raw data (CSV) so users can inspect clipped extremes offline if needed.
